title: Harry Styles ramps up Together, Together with another dozen cities
summary: Harry Styles has expanded his Together, Together run, adding 25 new stadium dates across 12 cities in 2027 to wrap up the global trek. title: AC/DC Toronto show cancelled after ‘hundred year storm’ damages Rogers Stadium
summary: AC/DC’s 16 September concert at Toronto’s Rogers Stadium has been cancelled due to extensive damage caused to the venue by a storm. Amid severe weather conditions which began last week, the stadium sustained damage which includes whole blocks of seating collapsing. Toronto’s city government has now issued an Unsafe Building Order for the stadium, with the venue itself saying sections of the building will now need to be removed and rebuilt. summary: When Sektor6D opens its doors tomorrow (11 September), it will become the Polish capital’s largest indoor concert venue, filling a major hole in the city’s touring landscape while capitalising on the demand for electronic music in the Eastern European market. summary: New Zealand has announced plans to establish a major events funding scheme to attract international cultural events, the latest in a series of efforts to enhance the country’s concert-hosting capabilities. title: Glastonbury tickets reach highest-ever price for 2027
summary: Following its 2026 fallow year, Glastonbury organisers have confirmed ticket prices will top £400 (€465) for the first time in the famed festival’s history. Tickets for the UK festival’s next edition, set for 23-27 June 2027, will cost attendees £408 (€475), which includes a £5 (€6) booking fee, a roughly 8% bump in price from 2025’s fee-inclusive price of £378.50 (€440). Since 2023, the cost of a general Glastonbury ticket has risen around 6% between editions, after rising around 26% from 2019 to 2023 during the pandemic-caused pause .
